correctness.rationale: PASS: In a full-step fixed state, an east car moving into a previously empty site cannot be replaced by a north car as an east-labelled occupant; so there are no east movements, then no north movements. Thus the exact local east and north blocking predicates characterize fixedness in both directions. Vertically legal columns are exactly 18 of 27 ternary triples; the cross-column east predicate builds an 18x18 weighted adjacency with a bijection between labelled configurations and length-n closed walks. The trace/log-det identity yields the whole bivariate law for arbitrary n. I independently enumerated all 18 columns and computed the exact integer characteristic polynomial t^10 times the two claimed quartics and traces n=3..9=1686,19988,237828,2829334,33652161,400231244,4759942476. Rouché on |t|=11 singles out the first quartic root in (11,12); the second quartic roots have modulus<=10 by Cauchy, establishing unique spectral dominance. Numerical perturbation of the weighted matrix independently reproduced species means ~1.28838 and ~1.29490 per column, giving the stated occupied fraction. The finite transfer matrix is an exact all-n reduction, unlike a sample-based extrapolation.
